questions.prompt: On a Linux workstation, the route command takes a long time before printing out the routing table. Which of the following errors does that indicate?

options.text: The local routing information may be corrupted and must be re-validated using a routing protocol.
One of the routers in the routing table is not available which causes the automatic router failure detection mechanism (ARF-D) to wait for a timeout.
There may accidentally be more than one default router in which case a default router election has to be done on the n etwork in order to choose one router as the default.
The Linux Kernel Routing Daemon (LKRD) is not running and should be started using its init script or systemd unit.
DNS resolution may not be worki ng as route by default tries to resolve names of routers and destinations and may run into a timeout.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 109 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: Which daemon handles power management events on a Linux system?
questions.explanation: acpid ( Advanced Configuration and Power Interface event daemon ) es el demonio encargado de escuchar y despachar eventos de gestión de energía del hardware (como pulsar el botón de encendido, cerrar la tapa del portátil o cambios en la batería) hacia el espacio de usuario ( man 8 acpid ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following entries in /etc/syslog.conf writes all mail related events to the file /var/log/maillog and sends all critical events to the remote server logger.example.com?
questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 108 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

options.text: IPv6 no longer supports broadcast addresses.
With IPv6, the TCP port numbers of most services have changed.
IPv4 addresses can be used without any change with IPv6.
IPv6 no longer supports multicast addresses.
For I Pv6, UDP and TCP have been replaced by the Rapid Transmission Protocol RTP.

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands prints a list of usernames (first column) and their primary group (fourth column) from the /etc/passwd file?
questions.explanation: El comando cut extrae columnas de archivos de texto. La opción -d : define los dos puntos como delimitador de campos, y -f 1,4 selecciona el primer y cuarto campo de cada línea ( man 1 cut ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands shows all active systemd timers?
questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 105 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: How does the ping command work by default?

options.text: It sends an ICMP Echo Request to a remote host and waits to receive an ICMP Echo Response in return.
It sends an ARP request to a remote host and waits to receive an ARP response in return.
It sends a TCP SYN packet to a remote host and waits to receive an TCP ACK response in return.
It sends a broadcast packet to all hosts on the net and waits to receive, among others, a respon se from the target system.
It sends a UDP packet to port 0 of the remote host and waits to receive a UDP error response in ret urn.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 109 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: If the gzip compressed tar archive texts.tgz contains the files a.txt and b.txt, which files will be present in the current directory after running gunzip texts.tgz?
questions.explanation: Según man 1 gunzip , gunzip descomprime el archivo y reemplaza el original por la versión descomprimida. Además, reconoce la extensión abreviada .tgz como equivalente a .tar.gz , por lo que al descomprimir texts.tgz lo renombra automáticamente a texts.tar (sin extraer el empaquetado tar).

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands can identify the PID od a process which opened a TCP port?
questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 109 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: Consider the following directory: drwxrwxr-x 2 root sales 4096 Jan 1 15:21 sales . Which command ensures new files created within the directory sales are owned by the group sales? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Cuando se activa el bit SetGID sobre un directorio, todos los archivos y subdirectorios nuevos creados dentro de él heredan automáticamente el grupo propietario del directorio ( sales ) en lugar del grupo primario del usuario creador. Esto se configura en modo simbólico con chmod g+s sales o en modo octal anteponiendo un 2 a los permisos actuales ( 775 ): chmod 2775 sales .

questions.prompt: Which of the following is true regarding the command sendmail?

options.text: With any MTA, the sendmail command must be run periodically by the cron daemon.
When using systemd, sendmail is an alias to relayctl.
The sendmail command prints the MTA's queue history of which mails have been sent successfully.
It is only available when the sendm ail MTA is installed.
All common MTAs, including Postfix and Exim, provide a sendmail comma nd.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 108 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: What command, depending on its options, can display the open TCP connections, the routing tables, as well as network interface statistics? (Specify only the command without any path or parameters.).
questions.explanation: netstat (de la suite net-tools ) es la herramienta multifunción clásica que muestra conexiones abiertas (por defecto o -t ), la tabla de enrutamiento ( -r ) y estadísticas de las interfaces de red ( -i o -s ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands can be used to limit the amount of memory a user may use?
questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 105 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: Which of the following properties of a Linux system should be changed when a virtual machine is cloned? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Al clonar una máquina virtual, los identificadores criptográficos y de sistema únicos deben regenerarse para evitar conflictos de red, problemas de gestión y fallos de seguridad. Específicamente, se deben regenerar las claves de host SSH ( /etc/ssh/ssh_host_* ) y el identificador único de máquina de D-Bus/systemd ( /etc/machine-id o /var/lib/dbus/machine-id ).

questions.prompt: Given the following user's crontab entry: 15 14 * * 1-5 /usr/local/bin/example.sh When will the script /usr/local/bin/example.sh be executed?

options.text: At 14:15 local time, January till May.
At 15:14 local time, 1st to 5th day of month.
At 14:15 local time, February till June.
At 14:15 local time, 1st to 5th day of month.
At 14:15 local time, Monday to Frida y.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 107 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: Which file, if present, must contain all users that are allowed to use the cron scheduling system? (Specify the full name of the file, including path.).
questions.explanation: Si el archivo /etc/cron.allow existe en el sistema, solo los usuarios listados explícitamente dentro de él tienen permiso para usar crontab (ignorando /etc/cron.deny ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands installs the GRUB boot files into the currently active file systems and the boot loader into the first partition of the first disk?
questions.explanation: En la nomenclatura de discos de Linux, el primer disco es /dev/sda y su primera partición se numera empezando en 1: /dev/sda1 .

questions.prompt: Which command makes the shell variable named VARIABLE visible to subshells?
questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 105 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: Which command, available with all sendmail-compatible MTAs, is used to list the contents of the MTA's mail queue? (Specify only the command without any path or parameters.).
questions.explanation: mailq (equivalente a sendmail -bp ) es el comando estándar proporcionado por todos los MTA compatibles con Sendmail (incluyendo Postfix y Exim) para listar los correos encolados pendientes de entrega.

questions.prompt: Which of the following settings for umask ensures that new files have the default permissions -rw-r----- ?
questions.explanation: Los permisos base de creación para archivos regulares son 0666 ( rw-rw-rw- ). Queremos obtener -rw-r----- ( 0640 ). Con umask 0027 , se enmascaran (desactivan) el permiso de escritura del grupo ( 2 ) y todos los permisos de otros ( 7 ), dando como resultado 0640 .

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands installs all packages with a name ending with the string foo?
questions.explanation: En SUSE/openSUSE, el gestor de paquetes zypper utiliza el subcomando install (o in ) y soporta comodines de tipo glob ( * y ? ). "*foo" coincide con cualquier paquete cuyonombre termine en foo ( man 8 zypper ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following files exist in a standard GRUB 2 installation? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: En GRUB 2 ya no existen los antiguos archivos stage1 / stage2 de GRUB Legacy; en su lugar utiliza un archivo de configuración principal llamado /boot/grub/grub.cfg y carga módulos dinámicos ( .mod ) organizados por arquitectura (como /boot/grub/i386-pc/lvm.mod ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following are valid stream redirection operators within Bash? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: En Bash ( man 1 bash ), es el operador estándar de redirección de entrada, y 2>&1 redirige el descriptor de archivo 2 ( standard error ) al mismo destino al que apunta el descriptor 1 ( standard output ). El operador >>> no existe en Bash (existe para here-strings ).

questions.prompt: What is the first program the Linux kernel starts at boot time when using System V init?
questions.explanation: En sistemas basados en SysVinit, una vez montado el sistema de archivos raíz, el kernel busca y ejecuta por defecto el binario /sbin/init .

questions.prompt: On a machine running several X servers, how do programs identify the different instances of the X11 server?

options.text: By a fixed UUID that is defined in the X11 configuration file.
By the name of the user that runs the X server like x11: bob.
By a unique IPv6 address from the fe80::/64subne t.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 106 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: A faulty kernel module is causing issues with a network interface card. Which of the following actions ensures that this module is not loaded automatically when the system boots?

options.text: Using lsmod --remove --autoclean without specifying the name of a specific module.
Using modinfo -k followed by th e name of the offending module.
Using modprobe -r followed by the name of the offending module.
Adding a blacklist line including the name of the offending module to the file /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist.conf.
Deleting the kernel module's directory from the file system and recompiling the kernel, including its modules.

questions.explanation: Según man 5 modprobe.d , añadir la directiva blacklist en un archivo .conf dentro de /etc/modprobe.d/ hace que se ignoren todos los alias internos del módulo, evitando que udev / modprobe lo carguen automáticamente al detectar el hardware durante el arranque.

questions.prompt: Which of the following steps prevents a user from obtaining an interactive login session?

options.text: Setting the UID for the user to 0.
Running the command chsh -s /bin/false with the user name.
Removing the user from the group staff.
Creating a .nologin file in the user's home directory.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of TCP wrapper?

options.text: A ) Manage and adjust bandwidth used by TCP services.
Bind a network service to a TCP port.
Encapsulate TCP messages in IP packets.
Add SSL support to plain text TCP services.
Limit access to a network service.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements about systemd-journald are true? (Choose three.).

options.text: It is incompatible with syslog and cannot be installed on a system using regular syslog.
It only processes messages of systemd and not messages of any other tools.
It can pass log messages to syslog for further processing.
It maintains metadata such as _UID or _PID for each me ssage.
It supports syslog facilities such as kern, user, and auth.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 108 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: How do shadow passwords improve the password security in comparison to standard no-shadow password?

options.text: Regular users do not have access to the password hashes of shadow passwords.
Every shadow password is valid for 45 days and must be changed afterwards.
The system's host key is used to encrypt all shadow passwords.
Shadow passwords are always combined with a public key that has to match the user's p rivate key.
Shadow passwords are stored in plain text and can be checked for weak passwords.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 110 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: What does the term Braille Display refer to?

options.text: A standardized high contract graphical theme for desktop applications?
A Linux desktop environment similar to KDE and GNOME.
A legacy display technology superseded by LCD.
A physical representation of characters using small dots.
A standard file format for data exchange, similar to XM L.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 106 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: Which of the following vi commands deletes two lines, the current and the following line?
questions.explanation: En el modonormal de vi / vim , el comando para eliminar una línea completa es dd . Al anteponer el multiplicador numérico 2 ( 2dd ), la operación se aplica a 2 líneas consecutivas empezando por la línea actual (también es válido d2d , pero de las opciones dadas solo 2dd es correcta).

questions.prompt: Given the following input stream: txt1.txt , atxt.txt , txtB.txt . Which of the following regular expressions turns this input stream into the following output stream? txt1.bak.txt , atxt.bak.txt , txtB.bak.txt
questions.explanation: Si usáramos s/txt/bak.txt/ , reemplazaría la primera aparición de txt al principio del nombre (dando bak.txt1.txt ). Al usar el ancla de final de línea $ en s/txt$/bak.txt/ , nos aseguramos de que solo reemplace el txt final después del punto, convirtiendo .txt en .bak.txt .

questions.prompt: In the vi editor, how can commands such as moving the cursor or copying lines into the buffer be issued multiple times or applied to multiple rows?

options.text: By using the command :repeat followed by the number and the command.
By specifying the number right in front of a command such as 41 or 2yj.
By selecting all affected lines using the shit and cursor keys before applying the command.
By is suing a command such as :set repetition=4 with repeats every subsequent command 4 times.
By specifying the number after a command such as 14 or yj2 followed by escape.

questions.explanation: En vi , cualquier comando de movimiento o edición en modonormal puede repetirse N N N veces escribiendo el número justo delante del comando (por ejemplo, 4l para avanzar 4 caracteres o 2yj para copiar la línea actual y las siguientes hacia abajo).

questions.prompt: What is true about the file /etc/localtime?

options.text: It is a plain text file containing a string such as Europe/Berlin.
It is created and maintained by the NTP service based on the location of the system's IP address.
It is a symlink to /sys/device/clock/ltime and always contains the current local time.
After changing this fil e, newtzconfig has to be run to make the changes effective.
It is either a symlink to or a copy of a tim ezone information f ile such as /usr/share/zoneinfo/Europe/Berlin.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 107 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements are true about the boot sequence of a PC using a BIOS? (Choose two.)

options.text: Some parts of the boot process can be configured from the BIOS.
Linux does not require the assistance of the BIOS to boot a computer.
The BIOS boot process starts only if secondary storage, such as the hard disk, is functional.
The BIOS initiates the boot process after turning the computer on.
The BIOS is started by loading hardware drivers from secondary storage, such as the hard di sk.

questions.explanation: Al encender el ordenador, el firmware BIOS se ejecuta desde la memoria no volátil de la placa base, realiza el POST ( Power-On Self-Test ) e inicia la secuencia de arranque. Además, desde la interfaz de configuración de la BIOS se pueden ajustar parámetros del arranque como el orden de los dispositivos ( boot order ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands puts the output of the command date into the shell variable mydate?
questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 105 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: What command is used to add OpenSSH private keys to a running ssh-agent instance? (Specify the command name only without any path.).
questions.explanation: El comando ssh-add carga las claves privadas del usuario (como ~/.ssh/id_rsa o ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 ) dentro del agente de autenticación ssh-agent activo.

questions.prompt: Which of the following situations is observed and corrected by an NTP client?

options.text: The skew in time between the system clock and the computer's hardware clock.
The physical location and the time zone configuration.
Changes in the time zone of the current computer's location.
Adjustment needed to support Dayligh t Saving Time.
The skew in time between the system clock and the reference clock.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 108 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 109 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: Which command is used to change the priority of an already running process? (Specify ONLY the command without any path or parameters.)
questions.explanation: Mientras que nice inicia un proceso nuevo con una prioridad dada, renice ( man 1 renice ) altera la prioridad de planificación ( niceness ) de uno o más procesos que ya están en ejecución .

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands finds all files owned by root that have the SetUID bit set?
questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 107 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: Which mechanism does ssh use to interact with the SSH agent?

options.text: Connecting to port 2222 which is used by the system-wide SSH agent.
Creating an alias replacing ssh with calls to ssh-agent.
Starting ssh-agent as a child process for each ssh invo cation.
Evaluating environment variables such as SSH_AUTH_SOCK.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 110 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands print the current working directory when using a Bash shell? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: El comando pwd ( print working directory ) muestra el directorio de trabajo actual, y Bash mantiene siempre actualizada la variable de entorno en mayúsculas $PWD con esa misma ruta.

questions.prompt: A user accidentally created the subdirectory \dir in his home directory. Which of the following commands will remote that directory?
questions.explanation: En Bash, la barra invertida \ es el carácter de escape. Para pasar una barra invertida literal en el nombre del directorio sin entrecomillar la tilde ~ (ya que ~ entre comillas "~/\dir" o '~/\dir' pierde su significado especial y no se expande al directorio home), hay que escapar la barra invertida con otra barra invertida: ~/\\dir .

questions.prompt: Which of the following tasks are handled by a display manager like XDM or KMD? (Choose two.).

options.text: Configure additional devices like new monitors or projectors when they are attached.
Start and prepare the desktop environment for the user.
Create an X11 configuration file for the current graphic devices and monitors.
Lock the screen when the user was inactive for a configurable amount of time.
Handle the login of a user.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 106 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands can be used to determine how long the system has been running? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: El comando uptime muestra directamente el tiempo que lleva encendido el sistema. Asimismo, la primera línea de cabecera del comando interactivo top muestra exactamente la misma información de tiempo de actividad ( uptime ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following directories on a 64 bit Linux system typically contain shared libraries? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: De acuerdo con el estándar FHS, las bibliotecas compartidas esenciales de 64 bits para el arranque y para los binarios de /bin y /sbin se almacenan en /lib64/ , mientras que las bibliotecas compartidas para las aplicaciones de /usr/bin y /usr/sbin se ubican en /usr/lib64/ .

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is true if the UID of a regular user is identical to the GID of a group?

options.text: UID have precedence over GIDs, therefore the user is available while the group doesn't.
The user as well as the group are not available to avoid ambiguity due to the ID conflict.
UIDs and GIDs are independent of each other, therefore the user as well as the group are still available.
The user is the only member of t he group, even if the group configuration contains other members.
GIDs have precedence over UIDs, therefore the group is available while the user is n't.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 105 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: If neither cron.allow nor cron.deny exist in /etc/, which of the following is true?

options.text: Without additional configuration, all users may create user specific crontabs.
Without additional configuration, only root may create user specific crontabs.
The cron daemon will refuse to start and report missing files in the system's logfile.
When a user creates a user specific crontab the system administrator must approve it explicit ly.
The default settings of /etc/crond.conf define whether or not user specific crontabs are generally allowed or not.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 107 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: What information is shown by the echo $? command?

options.text: The process ID of the echo command.
The exit value of the command executed immediately before echo.
The process ID which will be used for the next command.
The exit value of the echo command.
The process ID of the current shell.

questions.prompt: Which of the following settings for umask ensures that new files have the default permissions -rw-r----- ?
questions.explanation: Los permisos base de creación para archivos regulares son 0666 ( rw-rw-rw- ). Queremos obtener -rw-r----- ( 0640 ). Con umask 0027 , se enmascaran (desactivan) el permiso de escritura del grupo ( 2 ) y todos los permisos de otros ( 7 ), dando como resultado 0640 .

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands installs all packages with a name ending with the string foo?
questions.explanation: En SUSE/openSUSE, el gestor de paquetes zypper utiliza el subcomando install (o in ) y soporta comodines de tipo glob ( * y ? ). "*foo" coincide con cualquier paquete cuyonombre termine en foo ( man 8 zypper ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following files exist in a standard GRUB 2 installation? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: En GRUB 2 ya no existen los antiguos archivos stage1 / stage2 de GRUB Legacy; en su lugar utiliza un archivo de configuración principal llamado /boot/grub/grub.cfg y carga módulos dinámicos ( .mod ) organizados por arquitectura (como /boot/grub/i386-pc/lvm.mod ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following are valid stream redirection operators within Bash? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: En Bash ( man 1 bash ), es el operador estándar de redirección de entrada, y 2>&1 redirige el descriptor de archivo 2 ( standard error ) al mismo destino al que apunta el descriptor 1 ( standard output ). El operador >>> no existe en Bash (existe para here-strings ).

questions.prompt: What is the first program the Linux kernel starts at boot time when using System V init?
questions.explanation: En sistemas basados en SysVinit, una vez montado el sistema de archivos raíz, el kernel busca y ejecuta por defecto el binario /sbin/init .

questions.prompt: A faulty kernel module is causing issues with a network interface card. Which of the following actions ensures that this module is not loaded automatically when the system boots?

Using modprobe -r followed by the name of the offending module.
Adding a blacklist line including the name of the offending module to the file /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist.conf.

questions.prompt: Given the following input stream: txt1.txt , atxt.txt , txtB.txt . Which of the following regular expressions turns this input stream into the following output stream? txt1.bak.txt , atxt.bak.txt , txtB.bak.txt
